name: run-shape
description: The corpus-entry exports of the gauntlet harness, Tools/gauntlet/harness/run.mjs (loadEntries and validateEntryShape), and their Jet twin, the Shape module of the jet_gauntlet_kit package (Tools/gauntlet/kit/Source/Shape.jet), #5072 c8, each run by a driver with one command per export: the entries a directory loads, tools and skips (measured, tool, unnamed, null- and number-named, unknown, empty and missing modes, JSON that is broken, an array or a number, and a directory with no entry.json); the shape issues of each loaded entry against a matrix (HTTP probes, names, languages, not-applicable and metric-applicability facts, matrix cells, authored and sourced provenance); and the shape issues of the repository's own entries against its matrix (none).
